
[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:4[/yellow bold]

GPIO 36 has a hardware errata: interrupts may fire spuriously during WiFi/BT light sleep. Use a different pin for interrupt-driven input.

 [dim]3 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 2
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin battery: Analog = 36
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: GPIO 34, 35 do not have this errata.[/cyan]
